# Spring Festival Gala Dance Robot Recreation: Complete Practical Record (2026 Version)

This document records the key steps of installing, troubleshooting, and finally making the repository operational. The goal is to help new users avoid common pitfalls as much as possible.

Video tutorial (official website): https://www.datawhale.cn/learn/content/258/6228

Video tutorial (Bilibili): https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1gBfCBpEEb

Video tutorial supplement: https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1mjcXzLEGC/?share_source=copy_web&vd_source=cc2570142da6f3f02e6aba37bd88f313

Supplementary document: https://my.feishu.cn/docx/OzdvdvZ3LoSUfSxziNCcFWYFnqa?from=from_copylink

## 1. Project Objectives

- Input: text action description or existing video
- Output: robot actions `robot_motion*.pkl` and visualization (Web/viser/MuJoCo)
- Supports multi-robot trajectory (all tracks) and MuJoCo recording for multiple robots

## II. Core Process

```text
Prompt / Video -> PromptHMR -> SMPL-X -> GMR -> Robot Motion
```

Common commands:

```bash
python scripts/generate_video.py --model seedance --action "动作序列：角色向前走四步"
python scripts/extract_pose.py --project data/video_001
python scripts/convert_to_robot.py --project data/video_001 --all-tracks
python scripts/visualize.py --project data/video_001 --robot-viser --robot-all
```

## III. Environment Installation (Recommended)

### 0) Clone the new machine (do this first)

```bash
git clone https://github.com/datawhalechina/every-embodied.git
cd every-embodied/07-机器人操作、运动控制/Locomotion/video2robot
cd third_party
# 3. 克隆 GMR
git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/taeyoun811/GMR.git GMR
# 4. 克隆 PromptHMR
git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/taeyoun811/PromptHMR.git PromptHMR
cd ..
```

Instructions:

- All commands in this section are executed by default in the `every-embodied/07-机器人操作、运动控制/Locomotion/video2robot` directory.

If you receive a patch delivery package, apply 3 more patches:

```bash
git apply patches/main.patch
git -C third_party/PromptHMR apply ../../patches/prompthmr.patch
git -C third_party/GMR apply ../../patches/gmr.patch
```

Then create the environment with YAML in one click:

```bash
conda env create -f envs/gmr.yml
conda config --add envs_dirs /root/gpufree-data/conda_envs
# 第一个环境安装在系统盘，第二个安装在数据盘，避免超过磁盘负荷（系统和数据盘分别为30G和50G）
conda env create -f envs/phmr.yml
```

If the environment name already exists:

```bash
conda env update -n gmr -f envs/gmr.yml --prune
conda env update -n phmr -f envs/phmr.yml --prune
```

```bash
conda create -n gmr python=3.10 -y
conda activate gmr
cd /root/gpufree-data/every-embodied/07-机器人操作、运动控制/Locomotion/video2robot
```

If automatic installation fails, use the manual approach (see "Manual Configuration Approach" below).

## IV. Web UI Launch (Stable Version)

```bash
conda activate phmr
python -m pip install -U fastapi "uvicorn[standard]" jinja2 python-multipart

pkill -f "video2robot/visualization/robot_viser.py"
cd /root/gpufree-data/every-embodied/07-机器人操作、运动控制/Locomotion/video2robot
export VISER_FIXED_PORT=8789
python -m uvicorn web.app:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000
```

If `conda run -n phmr` is not found in GPFree or background tasks, with no write permission, or an abnormal environment name parsing, use the absolute environment path instead:

```bash
VISER_FIXED_PORT=8789 /root/gpufree-data/conda_envs/phmr/bin/python -m uvicorn web.app:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000
```

Access: `http://localhost:8000`

After starting, it is recommended to use the interface to confirm that the Web service is actually available. Do not just check whether `uvicorn` is running:

```bash
curl http://127.0.0.1:8000/health
curl http://127.0.0.1:8000/
curl http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/projects
curl http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/viser/status
```

Instructions:
- Using fixed `VISER_FIXED_PORT` is to avoid connection rejection due to random port in iframe.
- The web interface supports Chinese, Seedance, video uploading, and iron/color switching.

- DouBao web interface generates robot video prompts: help me generate images: help me optimize the prompt, create Chinese martial arts videos, with the characters completely within the video frame.
- Just upload and run the video; refer to the video tutorial for details.

- Some small torch models will be automatically downloaded during execution. If the download fails, try manual download.
  ```
  mkdir -p /root/.cache/torch/hub/checkpoints && rm -f /root/.cache/torch/hub/v0.10.0.zip.*.partial && wget -O /root/.cache/torch/hub/v0.10.0.zip https://github.com/pytorch/vision/zipball/v0.10.0 && wget -O /root/.cache/torch/hub/checkpoints/deeplabv3_resnet50_coco-cd0a2569.pth https://download.pytorch.org/models/deeplabv3_resnet50_coco-cd0a2569.pth && ls -lh /root/.cache/torch/hub/v0.10.0.zip /root/.cache/torch/hub/checkpoints/deeplabv3_resnet50_coco-cd0a2569.pth
  ```


Instructions:
- Fixed the "0 seconds/super short video" issue by strictly controlling the duration based on frames.
- Fixed the "only the ground is visible, no robots" issue, where the camera follows the center of multiple robots.

## VII. Challenges in Implementation and Prospects of IsaacSim Simulation

### Realistic Implementation Challenges
1. **Action mapping accuracy**: There are physical limitations in the retargeting of SMPL-X poses extracted from videos to robot joints.
2. **Lack of environmental awareness**: Currently, it is mainly about replicating open loop actions, without real-time feedback on actual ground friction, collisions, and obstacles.
3. **Dynamics constraints**: Human movements in videos may exceed the motor torque or balance limits of robots. For example, during the martial arts robot performance at the Ma Spring Festival Gala, high-level hovering and force conditions require extremely high servo response capabilities.

### Advantages of IsaacSim Simulation
In the future, we will introduce **IsaacSim** for reinforcement learning training:
- **Advantages**: High physical simulation accuracy, supporting complex collision detection, friction models, and sensor simulation.
- **Value**: For this project, the "action mapping" is mainly completed, while IsaacSim is responsible for "action robustness training".

## VIII. Quick Reference for Common Issues and Debug Records

### Q1: `conda` cannot be found (web task timeout)
It has been fixed in the main repository task runner, and automatic detection of `CONDA_EXE` is supported.

### Q2: robot-viser occasional `localhost 拒绝连接`
Use fixed port first: `export VISER_FIXED_PORT=8789`.

### Q3: MuJoCo recording reports that `imageio` backend is missing
Execute: `pip install -U "imageio[ffmpeg]"`.

### Q4: Compilation error (lietorch/droid_backends)
For PyTorch 2.4+, `.type()` should be changed to `.scalar_type()`.

### Q5: Unable to download files; download locally
1. Model file phase (the most critical issue)
The errors that often occur when running `python scripts/extract_pose.py --project data/video_001` are essentially of the same type:
- invalid load key, 'v'
- UnpicklingError
- weights_only ... Unsupported operand 118
- Cannot load file ... allow_pickle=False
These indicate that the downloaded files cannot be used properly.
2. Download and verify locally (example)

1) Download (HF single file)
```bash
$env:HF_ENDPOINT="https://hf-mirror.com"
$env:HF_HUB_DISABLE_XET="1"

python - << 'PY'
from huggingface_hub import hf_hub_download
p = hf_hub_download(
    repo_id="Datawhale/spring-festival-wushu-robot-replication-model",
    filename="data/pretrain/phmr/checkpoint.ckpt",
    repo_type="model",
    local_dir=r"E:\...\model_tmp",
    force_download=True
)
print("saved:", p)
PY
```
Local execution may not run the above Python code properly. You need to create a new file.
```python
from huggingface_hub import hf_hub_download
p = hf_hub_download(
    repo_id="Datawhale/spring-festival-wushu-robot-replication-model",
    filename="data/pretrain/phmr/checkpoint.ckpt",
    repo_type="model",
    local_dir=r"E:\...\model_tmp",
    force_download=True
)
print("saved:", p)
```
Save as test.py file python test.py
2) Local verification (must pass)
```python
import torch
p=r"E:\...\model_tmp\data\pretrain\phmr\checkpoint.ckpt"
with open(p,'rb') as f:
    print("first16:", f.read(16))
obj=torch.load(p, map_location='cpu', weights_only=False)
print("torch.load OK:", type(obj))
```
Verification criteria
- first16 cannot be b'version https://'
- torch.load OK shows normal output
3) Server verification
Similar to the above verification methods

### Q6: `git lfs clone` is very slow or fails repeatedly
Prioritize placing long-duration download tasks in the `tmux` backend, and ensure the download directory is correct. If a partial download has already been made, enter the corresponding model repository directory and execute `git lfs pull` to continue the download. When the domestic network is unstable, try `hf-mirror.com`, and confirm that the terminal traffic actually passes through a proxy; some proxy software only proxies the browser, not necessarily the remote terminal automatically.

### Q7: Web UI stuck at 96%/99%
This is not necessarily a front-end issue. Prioritize checking the backend logs, task processes, and model weights to ensure they are complete, as well as whether the project output files have been generated. When there are missing multi-person videos or model weights, the front-end progress may also remain stationary for a long time.

### Q8: `conda run -n phmr/gmr` failed in the GPFree environment
If the environment is actually located in `/root/gpufree-data/conda_envs/phmr` or `/root/gpufree-data/conda_envs/gmr`, use an absolute path for execution:

```bash
conda run -p /root/gpufree-data/conda_envs/phmr ...
conda run -p /root/gpufree-data/conda_envs/gmr ...
```


## 9. Warehouse Organization Suggestions (integrate into main warehouse, abandon old warehouse)

It is recommended to maintain `video2robot` as a regular directory in the main repository, and no longer use submodules (this is the only recommended approach at present).

Reasons:
- The old repository `hope5hope/video2robot` is about to be abandoned. Continuing to use the submodule will increase the risk of failure.
- The team wants "tutorials and code in the same repository" to reduce the cost for new members in switching repositories.
- Future modifications can be submitted, reviewed, and released directly in the main repository.


### Record baseline commit
- Main repository: `030f3410dac3cb15a2570376dca6a0f46c2d158c`
- PromptHMR: `4f8915c5b9603344c56e95fadb9a01a23ba2272d`
- GMR: `069b4fd48f440e813b2b4d69255c70f53e5f83fb`

`hope5hope/video2robot` is retained as a historical warehouse for reference only and is no longer used as the main development and delivery warehouse.

## 11. YAML Export and Cross-machine Replication Instructions

Export on the "source machine":

```bash
cd /root/gpufree-data/every-embodied/07-机器人操作、运动控制/Locomotion/video2robot
mkdir -p envs
conda env export -n gmr > envs/gmr.yml
conda env export -n phmr > envs/phmr.yml
```

Import into "Target Machine":

```bash
git clone https://github.com/datawhalechina/every-embodied.git
cd every-embodied/07-机器人操作、运动控制/Locomotion/video2robot
conda env create -f envs/gmr.yml
conda env create -f envs/phmr.yml
```

Apply 3 more patches (if your clone depends on local changes):

```bash
git apply patches/main.patch
git -C third_party/PromptHMR apply ../../patches/prompthmr.patch
git -C third_party/GMR apply ../../patches/gmr.patch
```

Instructions:
- YAML will not automatically include "uncommitted source code changes" and "model weight files".
- Therefore, it is recommended to deliver the `YAML + patch + 模型下载脚本` trio together, as this ensures the highest success rate of replication.

Update the download script:
https://github.com/hope5hope/video2robot/blob/main/%E6%96%87%E4%BB%B6%E6%9B%B4%E6%96%B0%E8%AF%B4%E6%98%8E.md

Download relevant model weights (recommended method):
```bash
git-lfs install
git lfs clone https://huggingface.co/Datawhale/spring-festival-wushu-robot-replication-model
或者国内镜像
git lfs clone https://hf-mirror.com/Datawhale/spring-festival-wushu-robot-replication-model
```

The large model download takes a long time. It is recommended to execute it in the `tmux` backend to avoid interruption due to terminal disconnection. Before downloading, also ensure that the current directory is:

```bash
cd /root/gpufree-data/every-embodied/07-机器人操作、运动控制/Locomotion/video2robot/third_party/PromptHMR
tmux new-session -d -s phmr_lfs_download 'git lfs clone https://hf-mirror.com/Datawhale/spring-festival-wushu-robot-replication-model'
tmux attach -t phmr_lfs_download
```

If the repository has already downloaded some files but the LFS files are incomplete, do not delete and re-download directly. Instead, enter the model repository directory to transfer the files later:

```bash
git lfs pull
```

Download relevant model weights (alternative):
```bash
cd /root/gpufree-data/every-embodied/07-机器人操作、运动控制/Locomotion/video2robot/third_party/PromptHMR
bash scripts/fetch_smplx.sh
bash scripts/fetch_data.sh
```

Note: `fetch_smplx.sh` does not only download SMPL-X. The script will also download SMPL and supplementary files. The fact that `data/body_models/smplx/SMPLX_NEUTRAL.npz` exists does not mean that all model files have been downloaded.

### Merge Patch command (for quick synchronization of changes)
If you are syncing based on the original repository, you can use the following command to merge patches:

```bash
cd /root/gpufree-data/every-embodied/07-机器人操作、运动控制/Locomotion/video2robot

# 1. 确保子模块已初始化
git submodule update --init --recursive

# 2. 应用主仓库补丁
git apply patches/main.patch

# 3. 应用 PromptHMR 补丁
git -C third_party/PromptHMR apply ../../patches/prompthmr.patch

# 4. 应用 GMR 补丁
git -C third_party/GMR apply ../../patches/gmr.patch
```
